name: Nari Miko
source:
Ever since the shrine maiden known as the “Narimiko” passed away, storms have been raging in the village of the protagonist, Ryoto.

"The storms should stop once the next Narimiko is chosen... I’ve decided to go to the Island of the Gods to become the next Narimiko.
There’s a guardian deity on the island, and since it’s powerful and dangerous, I want you to come with me."

Convinced by his childhood friend, the shrine maiden Nayu, Ryoto fell for her invitation hook, line, and sinker.
Ryoto followed her, fully prepared to fight, but the island’s guardian deities kept making lewd remarks...
translation:
自从被称为“成子”的巫女去世后，主人公凉人的村庄就陷入了风暴。

“一旦选择了下一个成子，风暴就会停止……我决定去众神之岛成为下一个成子。
岛上有守护神，它强大又危险，我想让你跟我一起去。”

良人被他儿时的朋友、巫女那由所说服，爱上了她的邀请函。
凉人跟在她身后，做好了战斗的准备，但岛上的守护神却不断地发出猥亵的言论……
